records.title: Anchor Forcing: Anchor Memory and Tri-Region RoPE for Interactive Streaming Video Diffusion
records.reason: Anchor Forcing stores junction-frame KV states alongside a rolling local cache for interactive long-video diffusion. This is close to streaming/KV-cache management, but architecture is video diffusion, not an LLM.

records.title: Real Money, Fake Models: Deceptive Model Claims in Shadow APIs
records.reason: The work analyzes third-party shadow model API claims and risks; it is not a model inference optimization.

records.title: MiroFlow: Towards High-Performance and Robust Open-Source Agent Framework for General Deep Research Tasks
records.reason: MiroFlow is a general deep-research agent framework and describes cost-efficient deployment, but body evidence centers on workflow/task results rather than quantified LLM inference compute, context, or serving improvements.
